rule: Each accepted difference from Microsoft MS-MPI 10.1.3 names its check, side and reason. Everything else must match.

differing.mspms.h: Upstream commit 12244d3 (2019-12-29) adds a guarded block (ADDRESS_FAMILY/SOCKADDR_INET and SAL fallbacks) for MinGW GCC <= 5.1 headers. It is inactive for MSVC and Intel compilers, which define _WS2IPDEF_ and the SAL macros; Microsoft's 10.1.3 SDK predates or omits it.
differing.pmidbg.h: The comment header block differs only in its copyright/licence lines (the public repository adds the MIT licence line); declarations are identical.
